transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Saturday, November 28. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. China helping Pak boost space capability, we need to enhance our capabilities: CDS. General N S Raja Subramani observed that Pakistan's advancements in space technology are being bolstered by collaboration with China and Turkey. He underscored the critical role of India's Space-Based Surveillance Phase-III initiative in strengthening national security. The General also addressed the integration of tech in military strategies, advocating for reforms in equipment procurement. Mumbai man rapes 60-year-old woman in Ghatkopar railway station washroom. In a shocking incident at Ghatkopar railway station, a 60-year-old woman was attacked in a washroom late Thursday night while with her daughter. The suspect, recorded by CCTV, entered the facility shortly before midnight. After reporting the assault, the woman helped authorities quickly track down the attacker, leading to the arrest of a 25-year-old man, Taslim Noor Mohammad. OpenAI sues Apple, says company rehired ex-worker to steal secret AI device plans. OpenAI has launched a countersuit against Apple, alleging the tech giant misappropriated trade secrets and created a climate of fear among its workers with restrictive policies. This legal clash began when Apple accused OpenAI of poaching its employees. OpenAI contends that Apple acquired sensitive data from a former staff member who briefly joined its ranks. Furthermore, OpenAI claims Apple's internal systems ensnare outgoing staff and facilitate ongoing surveillance. Cold coffee, cigarettes and food orders: 'Cyber trap' that didn't look like one. Delhi Police dismantled a cyber fraud syndicate operating from Noida, rescuing 164 foreign nationals exploited in fraudulent activities. The syndicate, led by a Malaysian man, trained recruits in other countries before bringing them to India. Allegations included working under duress and facing financial pressure, though no complaints of torture were reported. The authorities seized numerous electronic devices and passports during the operation. Florida man jailed for 47 months after using AI to clone streamer's voice in $260K scam. In a daring scheme, David Anthony Sanchez pretended to be the well-known streamer N3ON to swindle cryptocurrency enthusiasts, pocketing around $260,000. By leveraging fake profiles, deceptive contracts, and AI-generated voice technology, he crafted an illusion of credibility. His 47-month prison sentence follows his guilty plea, and while he faces restitution to his victims, the specifics remain under wraps. This incident underscores the growing threat of AI-driven scams. 'SC must review its order': TN Cong as top court directs deepam lighting at Deepathoon. Manickam Tagore, president of the Tamil Nadu Congress committee, has urged a review by the Supreme Court regarding its recent decision mandating the lighting of a ceremonial lamp at Madurai's Deepathoon stone pillar. This order has sparked concerns over federal principles, judiciary roles, and temple administration. Previous Supreme Court directives on security forces for the event's smooth execution have raised questions about the implications for religious harmony among communities. Boy's promise to repay neighbour's kindness feeds 29,000 families at Thanksgiving. Rob Adams fulfilled a childhood vow to assist needy families by establishing Thanksgiving Heroes. This initiative has grown nationwide, impacting over 29,000 families since it started. The organization prioritizes delivering meals to families selected by their communities, eliminating the need for proof of need. Local affiliates operate independently while maintaining the mission of families assisting families. Stalin to chair meeting of DMK MPs ahead of delimitation Bill. DMK president M K Stalin is set to chair a meeting of party MPs on Saturday as the Centre prepares to push a fresh delimitation-linked bill to implement women's reservation in Parliament. Punjab farmer shifts from wheat-paddy to fish farming, earns rupees 2.25 lakh per acre. Navjotpal Singh, a farmer from Ferozepur, transitioned to fish farming on six acres of land. He now produces around 15 tonnes of fish annually, yielding substantial returns for each acre. Singh has adopted scientific practices with support from Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University. His fish varieties were chosen based on profitability and local conditions, contributing to the increased interest in aquaculture. Texas grants SpaceX permit as data center approvals start before Hinojosa's term. SpaceX has obtained an air pollution permit for a natural gas power plant in Boca Chica, Texas. The plant is part of a larger supercomputing complex planned east of Brownsville. Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa has promised to pause new data center developments and end tax breaks for the industry. Local authorities are set to discuss a property tax break for the project on December 9.

Markets regulator Sebi is aiming to reduce the onboarding time for Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) from several months to as little as five business days through digital workflows and system integration, its chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said on Friday.
